scope: Post-key, nonblind content assessment of one response per arm. Difficulty ratings are judgments under the frozen 1–5 rubric, not a locked independent blind review.
cost_basis: Anthropic 2026-05-27 published AWS Bedrock US Geo Standard rates, $5.50/M input and $27.50/M output; reported tokens, before taxes/discounts; AWS bill may differ.

content_findings.repeated_mechanisms: All ten items apply either first double-space replacement/strip/skip or literal-space splitting; several differ chiefly by input values.

item_assessments.basis: Apply first-occurrence replacement to one string; strip changes nothing.
Count elements from one literal-space split.
Apply one delimiter distinction to a tab-containing string.
Trace skip, replacement, and strip across three list entries.
Apply first-occurrence replacement independently to two simple strings.
Trace skip, replacement, and strip across three list entries.
Apply literal-space splitting to one string.
Distinguish empty from whitespace-only input, then apply replacement.
Trace replacement and strip across three list entries.
Count elements from one literal-space split.

limits: One author response per arm on one Python goal; no statistical claim about relative model or schema accuracy.
The schema allows arbitrary array lengths and strings, so this run does not show that native formatting guarantees five useful or correct questions.
No separate solver/reviewer or locked blind difficulty review ran.
No provider output reached the 16,000-token cap.
